ae_item_base_info_dto.subject: 100pcs Bamboo Golf Tees - Eco-Friendly Professional Golf Tee Set Durable & Smooth Swing, Perfect for Golf Training & Competition
ae_item_base_info_dto.detail:
Product Highlights

✅ Eco-Friendly Material – Made of 100% natural bamboo, biodegradable and sustainable, safer for the environment than plastic or wooden tees.

✅ 5X Stronger Than Wood – Reinforced bamboo structure resists cracking and splintering, ensuring long-lasting performance.

✅ Smooth Swing & Consistent Height – Precision-designed for minimal friction and optimal ball flight, enhancing your accuracy.

✅ 100pcs Value Pack – Ample quantity for practice, tournaments, or sharing with friends. Never run out on the course!

✅ Universal Compatibility – Fits all standard golf clubs (drivers, irons, etc.) and conforms to USGA/R&A rules.



Specifications

Material: Natural bamboo

Quantity: 100 tees per pack

Color: Red, Yellow, White

Size:70mm/83mm



Perfect For:

Golf enthusiasts seeking eco-friendly gear

Coaches and training facilities

Tournament players needing reliable tees

Gift for golfers (birthdays, holidays, Father’s Day)

♻️ Go Green & Play Better – Upgrade Your Game with Bamboo Tees Today!
